trainer/30715.htm.text: Magister Marina: Welcome to the Ivory Tower! As you may know, this is a hallowed place of learning. Please respect that and speak softly. This is a particularly sensitive time...

trainer/30715-1.htm.text: Magister Marina: It is not something that should overly concern you, but Grand Magister Fairen on the 4th floor has been having some strange dreams. His nerves are on edge, so be extra careful near him. As a Dark Elf, he already has a quick temper. At present, he's a virtual powder keg waiting to e…

trainer/30715-noteach.htm.text: Magister Marina: Shhh...! Please be quiet. And, I an not the one you are looking for. Your teacher is on another floor. Check with Gatekeeper Cecilia, she'll head you in the right direction. Oh, and if you're a Cleric, it'd be best for you to visit the temple.

What joy the sound of that name brings me! There was a time when... Oh my, I mustn't go on in front of a guest... Shall we get down to business? My an…

Q00213_TrialOfTheSeeker/30715-03.html.text: Magister Marina: Go to Blacksmith Brunon of the Dwarven Village and bring back to me what I ordered from him.

links.text: Ask about the Agathion in charge of skill enchantment.

common/skill_enchant_help_01.htm.text: Skill Enchanting allows you to strengthen certain skills that have reached their maximum level. You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. To do this, open your skills win…

common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!

common/skill_enchant_help_03.htm.text: There are several Skill Enchanting options at your disposal: General Skill Enchant, Blessed Skill Enchant, Skill Un-Enchanting and Skill Route Change.
